iterate_json_leaves: iterate through each leaf in a nested JSON structure using json_iter_leaves
map_json_leaves: apply a function to each leaf in a nested JSON structure using json_map_leaves
reduce_json_leaves: reduce a nested JSON structure to a single value using json_reduce_leaves
count_json_leaves: count the number of leaves in a nested JSON structure using json_count_leaves
transform_json_tree: transform a nested JSON tree by mapping a function over all its leaves using json_map_leaves
